no_adcom_quote.quote: The application for Zepatier (elbasvir/grazoprevir) was not referred to an FDA Advisory Committee because this drug is not the first in its class, and its safety profile is similar to that of other drugs approved for this indication.

summary: No FDA Advisory Committee was convened for Zepatier (NDA208261). The Office Director memo, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Summary Review all state the application was not referred to an AC because neither drug in the fixed-dose combination was first-in-class, efficacy was robust across subpopulations, and the main safety issue (exposure-related transaminase elevations) was monitorable/manageable; the product also held breakthrough therapy designation, which is typically not taken to AC. (A separate Merck-commissioned independent DILI expert committee reviewed hepatic safety, but this was a sponsor consultation, not an FDA Advisory Committee.)
